narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a professional medical advisory warning patients against cutting costs on anesthesia. The creator emphasizes the life-threatening risks of having non-specialized personnel administer drugs like propofol and advocates for the mandatory presence of a licensed anesthesiologist (doctor) during major skin/aesthetic treatments, effectively positioning her clinic's rigorous standards as the safest choice.
